summary.html: Massive Strikes on Iran: US and Israeli forces have reportedly conducted massive, synchronized strikes in Iran, explicitly targeting Supreme Leader Khamenei and top IRGC leadership. Reports indicate Khamenei and numerous top officials have been killed, leading to widespread celebration among Iranian citizens both domestically and abroad.

Anthropic Banned by Federal Agencies: Following a dispute with the Department of War, the Trump administration has banned all federal agencies from using Anthropic’s models and labeled the company a supply-chain risk. OpenAI has publicly backed its own safety measures in comparison.

Bayern Munich Wins Der Klassiker: Bayern Munich secured a 3-2 victory over Borussia Dortmund, moving 11 points clear at the top of the Bundesliga table. Harry Kane scored his 30th league goal of the season.

items.title: Sam Altman (@sama)
items.body: Sam Altman addressed questions regarding OpenAI's work with the Department of War, noting that he believes in a close partnership between governments and AI companies, and that people take national security for granted.

items.title: The Economist (@TheEconomist)
items.body: In an unprecedented move against an American firm, the Trump administration banned all federal agencies from using Anthropic’s technology, designating the AI lab a 'supply-chain risk.'

items.title: OpenAI (@OpenAI)
items.body: OpenAI announced an agreement with the Department of War for deploying advanced AI in classified environments, claiming their deployment has more expansive, multi-layered guardrails than competitors.

items.title: Elon Musk (@elonmusk)
items.body: Elon Musk praised Grok, claiming that 'prediction of the future is the best measure of intelligence,' after the AI purportedly accurately predicted the exact date of the US/Israel strike on Iran.

items.title: SightBringer (@_The_Prophet__)
items.body: Analysis on President Trump confirming the death of Iran's Supreme Leader, Khamenei. The move is viewed as a psychological operation aimed at triggering a defection cascade and fracturing the regime's command structure.

items.title: FactSet (@FactSet)
items.body: 73% of S&P 500 companies have beaten EPS estimates for Q4, though this remains slightly below the 5-year average of 78%. All 11 sectors are reporting year-over-year earnings growth, led by IT and Industrials.

items.title: 麦田 Rye 🇺🇦 (@maitian99)
items.body: A trader notes shorting energy stocks ($XLE) ahead of the weekend in anticipation of a 'sell the news' reaction to potential strikes on Iran, utilizing a left-side trading strategy.

items.title: 孤军未死 (@Scswga)
items.body: Reports suggest the IRGC is broadcasting VHF warnings that the Strait of Hormuz is closed to shipping. With 20% of global oil relying on the strait, this escalation could cause massive volatility in energy markets.

items.title: Harry Kane (@HKane)
items.body: Bayern Munich secured a 3-2 comeback victory over Borussia Dortmund in Der Klassiker. Harry Kane praised the team's mentality as they extended their Bundesliga lead to 11 points.

items.body: European economists often look enviously at the economic dynamism across the Atlantic, suggesting that US states should also be more attuned to the sources of their own competitive advantages.

items.body: Highlighting the growing power of Brazil's Supreme Court amid government scandals, warning that its immense authority risks curdling without public trust and good faith.
